housing: Milwaukee is known for its upper-and-lower duplexes and 'Polish flats', alongside bungalows and warehouse lofts downtown.

climate: Cold winters mean you should test the furnace, check windows and doors for drafts, and photograph any ice damage, damp basements or frozen-pipe stains.
fact: Many Milwaukee renters live in one half of a duplex, often with the landlord or another household in the other unit.
